        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Current_ChC THEN
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC;
    ELSE
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters for Auxiliary Signals *)
rT_Bath_Filt_K    := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rT_Bath_Voted_K)    + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rT_Bath_Filt_K);
rP_Bath_Filt_Mbar := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rP_Bath_Filt_Mbar);
rT_Shield_Filt_K  := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rT_Shield_Voted_K)  + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rT_Shield_Filt_K);
rI_Current_Filt_A  := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rI_Current_Filt_A);

(* Magnet Energization Interlock Flag *)
bMagnetEnergized := (rI_Current_Filt_A > 60.0);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: INDUCTIVE COMPENSATION & QUENCH DETECTION BRIDGE BALANCE                           *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1. Compute moving derivative dI/dt [A/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rRawDIDT_As := (rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A - rI_Previous_A) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
ELSE
    rRawDIDT_As := 0.0;
END_IF;
rI_Previous_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A;
rDIDT_Filtered_As := (rDIDT_FilterAlpha * rRawDIDT_As) + ((1.0 - rDIDT_FilterAlpha) * rDIDT_Filtered_As);

(* 2. Estimate common-mode inductive voltage across each half-winding: V_ind = L_half * dI/dt *)
(* mV = (Henry * A/s) * 1000.0 *)
rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV := (rSelfInductance_Half1_H - rSelfInductance_Half2_H + rMutualInductance_H) * rDIDT_Filtered_As * 1000.0;

(* 3. Compute net resistive voltage for each 2oo3 bridge channel: *)
(* V_res = (V_half1 - V_half2) - V_ind_offset *)
rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChA - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChA) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;
rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChB - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChB) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;
rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChC - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChC) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;

(* 4. 2oo3 Median Voting on Resistive Voltage Signals *)
IF bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChB AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC THEN
    IF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV) THEN
        IF (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
        ELSIF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
        ELSE
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
        ELSIF (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
        ELSE
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel discrepancy verification *)
    IF (ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) OR
       (ABS(rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) OR
       (ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) THEN
        rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy := rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_Voted_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV THEN
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV - rV_Res_Voted_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV THEN
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChB) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChB AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_VoltTap_ChA THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
    ELSIF bHealth_VoltTap_ChB THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
    ELSIF bHealth_VoltTap_ChC THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
    ELSE
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := 500.0; (* Failsafe trip *)
        bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

rQuenchResistiveVoltage_mV := rV_Res_Voted_mV;

(* 5. Compute resistive voltage rate of change dV_res/dt [mV/ms] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs := (ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) - ABS(rV_Res_Previous_mV)) / (tScanDeltaTime_Sec * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs := 0.0;
END_IF;
rV_Res_Previous_mV := rV_Res_Voted_mV;

(* 6. Dual-Criteria Quench Discrimination Engine *)
IF bMagnetEnergized THEN
    (* Criterion A: Sustained resistive threshold exceedance (V_res >= 100 mV for >= 8 ms) *)
    IF ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) >= rQuenchVoltThreshold_mV THEN
        rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec >= rQuenchValidationTime_Sec THEN
            bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched := TRUE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Symmetrical decay of validation accumulator to avoid noise pumping *)
        IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec > 0.0 THEN
            rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec - (1.5 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
            IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec < 0.0 THEN rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Criterion B: Catastrophic fast quench propagation rate-of-rise (dV/dt >= 25 mV/ms) *)
    IF (rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs >= rFastQuenchDVDT_Threshold) AND (ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) >= 40.0) THEN
        bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: ACTION INTEGRAL (MIITs) & ADIABATIC NORMAL-ZONE HOTSPOT MODEL                      *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Action Integral MIITs = integral(I^2 * dt) in MA^2 * s *)
IF (bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched OR bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched OR (iStateStep >= 80)) THEN
    (* Current is decaying through dump resistor or localized arc *)
    rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s + (EXPT((rI_Current_Filt_A / 1000000.0), 2.0) * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
ELSIF (NOT bMagnetEnergized) THEN
    (* Decay accumulator slowly when magnet is completely de-energized *)
    IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s > 0.0 THEN
        rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s - (0.05 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s < 0.0 THEN rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s;

(* Adiabatic Hot-spot Inversion Model for Nb-Ti/Cu matrix *)
rHotSpot_T_Calc_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K + (rCoeff_Hotspot_k1 * rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s) +
                     (rCoeff_Hotspot_k2 * EXPT(rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s, 2.0)) +
                     (rCoeff_Hotspot_k3 * EXPT(rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s, 3.0));
rHotSpotEstimatedTemp_K := rHotSpot_T_Calc_K;

(* Interlock checks on thermal limits *)
IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s >= rMAX_PERMISSIBLE_MIITS THEN
    bTrip_MIITsLimit_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF rHotSpot_T_Calc_K >= rMAX_ALLOWABLE_HOTSPOT_K THEN
    bTrip_HotspotHigh_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: SUPERCONDUCTOR Nb-Ti CRITICAL SURFACE & STABILITY MARGIN                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Lubell parameterization: B_c2(T) = B_c20 * [1 - (T/T_c0)^1.7] *)
IF rT_Bath_Filt_K < rTc0_ZeroField_K THEN
    rCriticalField_Bc2_T := rBc20_ZeroTemp_T * (1.0 - EXPT((rT_Bath_Filt_K / rTc0_ZeroField_K), 1.7));
    IF rCriticalField_Bc2_T < 0.10 THEN rCriticalField_Bc2_T := 0.10; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCriticalField_Bc2_T := 0.10;
END_IF;

(* Current sharing temperature: T_cs(B, I) = T_c0 * (1 - B/B_c20)^0.59 * (1 - I/I_c0) *)
IF (rB_DipoleField_T < rBc20_ZeroTemp_T) AND (rI_Current_Filt_A < rIc0_Nominal_A) THEN
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rTc0_ZeroField_K * EXPT((1.0 - (rB_DipoleField_T / rBc20_ZeroTemp_T)), 0.59) *
                                 (1.0 - (rI_Current_Filt_A / rIc0_Nominal_A));
    IF rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K < rT_Bath_Filt_K THEN
        rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous coil critical temperature margin *)
rCoilMarginToCritical_K := rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K - rT_Bath_Filt_K;

(* Liquid Helium Boil-Off Rate Estimation: Q_dot / L_v *)
(* L_v of LHe ~ 20.8 kJ/kg ~ 2.6 J/cm^3 *)
rAccumulator := (rHeaterColdMass_Cmd_W + (0.00015 * EXPT(rI_Current_Filt_A, 1.8))) * 2.85; (* L/h equivalent *)
rHeliumBoiloffRate_Lh := rAccumulator;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: THERMO-ACOUSTIC TACONIS OSCILLATION RESONATOR & SPECTRAL DETECTOR                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Feed raw thermal shield temperature into 6.0 Hz 2nd-order resonant bandpass digital filter *)
rTAO_Input_Current := rT_Shield_Voted_K;
rTAO_Filtered_Current := (2.0 * rResonator_r * rResonator_CosTheta * rTAO_Filtered_Prev1) -
                         (EXPT(rResonator_r, 2.0) * rTAO_Filtered_Prev2) +
                         ((1.0 - rResonator_r) * (rTAO_Input_Current - rTAO_Input_Prev2));

(* Update filter delay lines *)
rTAO_Input_Prev2      := rTAO_Input_Prev1;
rTAO_Input_Prev1      := rTAO_Input_Current;
rTAO_Filtered_Prev2   := rTAO_Filtered_Prev1;
rTAO_Filtered_Prev1   := rTAO_Filtered_Current;

(* Peak envelope tracking via leaky peak follower *)
rTempDelta := ABS(rTAO_Filtered_Current);
IF rTempDelta > rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K THEN
    rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K := (0.35 * rTempDelta) + (0.65 * rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K);
ELSE
    rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K := rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K - (0.15 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    IF rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K < 0.0 THEN rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K := 0.0; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Thermal Shield Oscillation Damping Stability Index [0 to 100%] *)
IF rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K <= 0.05 THEN
    rThermalShieldStability_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K < 1.00 THEN
    rThermalShieldStability_Pct := 100.0 - (75.0 * (rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K - 0.05) / 0.95);
ELSE
    rThermalShieldStability_Pct := 25.0 * (1.0 - ((rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K - 1.0) / 2.0));
    IF rThermalShieldStability_Pct < 0.0 THEN rThermalShieldStability_Pct := 0.0; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Active Thermo-Acoustic Oscillation Flag *)
bThermalOscillationActive := (rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K >= rTAO_Threshold_Warning_K);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Compute output measurement innovation error: y_err = y_meas - C_d * x_hat *)
(* y_meas: [T_shield - 55.0, P_shield - 4500.0, A_osc, T_bath - 4.22] *)
rInnovation[1] := (rT_Shield_Filt_K - 55.0)  - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := (rP_Shield_Mbar - 4500.0)   - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K    - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (rT_Bath_Filt_K - 4.22)     - xState_Pred[4];

(* Kalman State Correction: x_hat = x_pred + L_Gain * innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := xState_Pred[iRow] + rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Evaluate Measured Disturbances: d[1] = Eddy Loss, d[2] = Vacuum Loss *)
dDisturbance[1] := 0.000045 * EXPT(rDIDT_Filtered_As, 2.0); (* AC eddy losses in W *)
IF rP_CryostatVacuum_Mbar > 1.0E-5 THEN
    dDisturbance[2] := 18.5 * LOG(rP_CryostatVacuum_Mbar * 1.0E5);
    IF dDisturbance[2] < 0.0 THEN dDisturbance[2] := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    dDisturbance[2] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Time Propagation for Next Cycle: x_pred(k+1) = A_d * x_est(k) + B_d * u(k) + E_d * d(k) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: DETERMINISTIC MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QP SOLVER                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Optimize control vector u = [delta_V_shield, delta_V_damper, delta_Heater, delta_RampRate] *)
(* using fast Projected Gradient Descent with barrier acoustic oscillation slack penalty *)

(* Compute soft barrier constraint penalty on acoustic resonance *)
IF xState_Est[3] > rTAO_Threshold_Warning_K THEN
    rAcousticSlack := xState_Est[3] - rTAO_Threshold_Warning_K;
ELSE
    rAcousticSlack := 0.0;
END_IF;

FOR iQPIter := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
    (* Compute cost function gradient: grad_J = R*u + B_d^T * Q * (C_d * x_est) + S*(u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := (vR_Diag[iCol] * uControl[iCol]) + (vS_Diag[iCol] * (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]));
        
        (* Projected state cost cross-terms *)
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
            rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * vQ_Diag[iRow] * xState_Est[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        
        (* Add acoustic resonance barrier pushback gradient *)
        IF iCol = 2 THEN (* Active damper valve CV-202 channel *)
            rAccumulator := rAccumulator - (rRhoAcousticPenalty * rAcousticSlack * 0.45);
        END_IF;
        
        rGradJ[iCol] := rAccumulator;
        
        (* Gradient descent step *)
        uControl[iCol] := uControl[iCol] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Box Bounds Clamping within QP Iteration Loop *)
    (* u[1]: Valve_Shield delta [-35.0 to +65.0%] *)
    IF uControl[1] < -35.0 THEN uControl[1] := -35.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 65.0 THEN uControl[1] := 65.0; END_IF;
    (* u[2]: Valve_Damper delta [-20.0 to +80.0%] *)
    IF uControl[2] < -20.0 THEN uControl[2] := -20.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 80.0 THEN uControl[2] := 80.0; END_IF;
    (* u[3]: Heater ColdMass delta [-15.0 to +135.0 W] *)
    IF uControl[3] < -15.0 THEN uControl[3] := -15.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 135.0 THEN uControl[3] := 135.0; END_IF;
    (* u[4]: Current Ramp Rate Clamp delta [-140.0 to +150.0 A/s] *)
    IF uControl[4] < -140.0 THEN uControl[4] := -140.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 150.0 THEN uControl[4] := 150.0; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Slew Rate Limit Enforcement between Scan Cycles *)
(* u[1] Slew *)
rDeltaU := uControl[1] - uControl_Prev[1];
rMaxDeltaU := rValveShield_MaxSlew_PctSec * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
IF rDeltaU > rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] + rMaxDeltaU;
ELSIF rDeltaU < -rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] - rMaxDeltaU; END_IF;

(* u[2] Slew *)
rDeltaU := uControl[2] - uControl_Prev[2];
rMaxDeltaU := rValveDamper_MaxSlew_PctSec * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
IF rDeltaU > rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[2] := uControl_Prev[2] + rMaxDeltaU;
ELSIF rDeltaU < -rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[2] := uControl_Prev[2] - rMaxDeltaU; END_IF;

(* u[3] Slew *)
rDeltaU := uControl[3] - uControl_Prev[3];
rMaxDeltaU := rHeaterColdMass_MaxSlew_WSec * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
IF rDeltaU > rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[3] := uControl_Prev[3] + rMaxDeltaU;
ELSIF rDeltaU < -rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[3] := uControl_Prev[3] - rMaxDeltaU; END_IF;

(* u[4] Slew *)
rDeltaU := uControl[4] - uControl_Prev[4];
rMaxDeltaU := rRampRateClamp_MaxSlew_AsSec * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
IF rDeltaU > rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[4] := uControl_Prev[4] + rMaxDeltaU;
ELSIF rDeltaU < -rMaxDeltaU THEN uControl[4] := uControl_Prev[4] - rMaxDeltaU; END_IF;

(* Store history for next iteration *)
FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
    uControl_Prev[iCol] := uControl[iCol];
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: 10-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) WITH COMPREHENSIVE CONTROL MODES              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;

(* State Transition History Tracking *)
IF iStateStep <> iPreviousState THEN
    iPreviousState := iStateStep;
    rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Global Priority Check for Trips *)
IF (bTrip_Hardwire_Latched OR bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched OR bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched OR
    bTrip_MIITsLimit_Latched OR bTrip_HotspotHigh_Latched OR bTrip_BathOverpressure_Latched OR
    bTrip_VacuumBreakdown_Latched OR bTrip_LeadCoolingLoss_Latched OR bTrip_CryoSevereThermal_Latched) THEN
    IF (iStateStep < 90) THEN
        iStateStep := 90; (* Jump to Quench Emergency Crowbar Dump *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_OFFLINE_VACUUM_PUMPDOWN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoConditionsValid := FALSE;
        bCrowbarDumpTrigger := FALSE;
        bBeamAbortInterlock := TRUE; (* Lock beam out *)
        rValveShieldFlow_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rValveDamper_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rHeaterColdMass_Cmd_W := 0.0;
        rValveQuenchVent_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentRampRate_Max_As := 0.0;

        (* Permissive to enter cooldown: Vacuum must be established < 1.0E-3 mbar *)
        IF bEnable AND (rP_CryostatVacuum_Mbar < 1.0E-3) AND (iCommandedMode >= 1) THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CRYOGENIC_COOL_DOWN_80K *)
        (* Controlled cool-down with LN2 / 80K cold helium gas *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoConditionsValid := FALSE;
        bBeamAbortInterlock := TRUE;
        rValveQuenchVent_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentRampRate_Max_As := 0.0;
        rHeaterColdMass_Cmd_W := 0.0;
        
        (* Thermal ramp rate restriction to avoid mechanical shear stresses: |dT/dt| < 25 K/hr *)
        rValveShieldFlow_Cmd_Pct := 20.0 + (15.0 * (1.0 - (rT_Shield_Voted_K / 295.0)));
        rValveDamper_Cmd_Pct := 10.0;

        (* Transition when thermal shield stabilizes < 85 K and cold mass < 90 K *)
        IF (rT_Shield_Voted_K <= 85.0) AND (rT_Bath_Voted_K <= 90.0) THEN
            IF iCommandedMode >= 2 THEN
                iStateStep := 20;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_CRYOGENIC_COOL_DOWN_4K2 *)
        (* Liquid helium transfer and 4.2K bath condensing phase *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoConditionsValid := FALSE;
        bBeamAbortInterlock := TRUE;
        rValveQuenchVent_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentRampRate_Max_As := 0.0;

        (* Modulate shield flow and bath fill *)
        rValveShieldFlow_Cmd_Pct := 35.0;
        rValveDamper_Cmd_Pct := 15.0;
        rHeaterColdMass_Cmd_W := 0.0;

        (* Check 4.2K liquid level condensation & thermal shield equilibrium *)
        IF (rT_Bath_Voted_K <= 4.25) AND (rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar >= 1150.0) AND
           (rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar <= 1350.0) AND (rT_Shield_Voted_K <= 65.0) THEN
            IF iCommandedMode >= 3 THEN
                iStateStep := 30;
